shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view.
- **MOUNTAIN RIVER HYDROLOGY (user spec, rounds 8-10):** water bodies key on **IsWater** (wide 1.6 rivers are composites: IsRiver core + still-water fringe; IsRiver is only a flow hint). Crossing forms: TUNNEL (thick roof over water) or CANYON (massif flanking both sides within CanyonFlankScan=16). Per contiguous stretch: ANY inflow crossing -> vanilla; ALL-outflow (mountain-source) -> LIFT (ground sealed solid + thick roof, water carved on the sky, lips at mass edges, surface water continues from the falls). Zero crossings (enclosed mountain lakes) -> vanilla. No flow data: single crossing = lift, multi = vanilla.
- **AUTO SKY GENERATION:** qualifying player home maps auto-generate the sky post-mapgen (same classifier, roof-based variant).
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED (round 7).

## RIVER REWORK v5 (round 10) — built compile-green, RELAUNCH PENDING
Round-9 live result: lift + falls WORKED (user: "almost there"; sky river + stepped lips confirmed in screenshots) but the still-water fringe of the wide river stayed wet on the surface ("two rivers"). v5 broadens every predicate (collection, crossings, seal, falls landing, diagnostics) from IsRiver to IsWater; enclosed lakes protected by zero-crossings; multi-crossing no-flow bodies default vanilla (ocean/coast safe).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · river lift + waterfalls fire on canyon rivers (USER round 9, seal completeness pending v5 verify).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: river diagnostic (IsWater counts) · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## Test plan (round 10)
1. Fresh quicktest on a mountain-source river tile: auto sky at landing; surface shows the cut FULLY sealed (no leftover still-water fringe — the v5 check); sky river over the massif; falls at the exit; surface water resuming below.
2. Through-river map: everything vanilla.
3. Standing stack afterward: below lighting, animal flow, direct-to-blueprint, BAM, Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting (sky view) · animal flow fix · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit · mountain rivers v5 (IsWater composite bodies + tunnel/canyon + auto sky) · Batch B/C built pending. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (19th pass): **v5 composite-water fix built compile-green** — the fringe seals with the core. Awaiting relaunch for the final river verify.
